- Hidden-browser video search: uses the installed Microsoft Edge or Chrome when available (no extra browser download), looks like a normal browser, clicks the player, and also recognizes streams by content type
- New `--debug` option: saves a screenshot and the list of requests of the hidden browser to `vd-debug` in the download folder
- Hints when the hidden browser is redirected to a login page
- Clear message with the cookies.txt workaround when Chrome/Brave/Edge cookies cannot be read on Windows (DPAPI)
